title: Battle of Arroyo Grande
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Arroyo Grande", at revision 1382683172, opens: "The Battle of Arroyo Grande took place on 6 December 1842 and was a major battle of the Uruguayan Civil War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4870349, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1842 engagement during the Uruguayan Civil War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
